about: What Dependabot cannot see: the Python tools that make the music, pinned in docs/audio/SOURCES.md, and the override in package.json that holds the linter on the fixed minimatch, each read by its pattern (never written here), for the core's monthly versions check (its format and workings: core/scripts/versions.mjs); each run of scripts/test.sh checks that each pattern still finds exactly one version.

entries.name: minimatch
entries.how: The override that keeps the linter (ESLint and typescript-eslint) off minimatch 10, which has a moderate advisory (#698): take the newer 11.x with @isaacs/nonrecursive-glob-match at a release at least a week old, and drop both overrides once ESLint and typescript-eslint ask for minimatch 11 themselves.
